description: This file contains automated UI tests for the reports CRUD interface of a web application, using Cypress framework commands to verify listing, searching, creating, editing, and deleting reports.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test by mocking API, logging in the user, navigating to reports page, and waiting for reports to load.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for listing and searching reports, creating a new report, editing an existing report, and deleting a report with confirmation.
